title: Reading Group: Optimization Methods for Large-Scale Machine Learning
description: Reading and discussion of Bottou, Curtis & Nocedal's foundational review of optimization methods for large-scale machine learning.

title: Reading Group: On the Importance of Initialization and Momentum in Deep Learning
description: Reading and discussion of the paper by Sutskever et al. on initialization, momentum, and optimization dynamics in deep learning.

title: Reading Group: Information-Based Objective Functions for Active Data Selection
description: Discussion of MacKay's paper on information-based objective functions for selecting informative data points.

title: Reading Group: Active Learning with Statistical Models
description: Discussion of Cohn's paper on active learning strategies based on statistical models and informative sampling.

title: Reading Group: Efficient Global Optimization of Expensive Black-Box Functions
description: Discussion of Jones et al.'s paper introducing Efficient Global Optimization for optimizing expensive black-box functions.
